'''Kanarak''', also known as '''Kanarak the Slayer''', was a vicious and undisciplined killer, he habitually carried a [["Flash" 4|Flash 4 heavy blaster pistol]], a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]], and a "death necklace" made from the [[Bone/Legends|bones]] of his victims. Kanarak was reptilian in appearance, with large teeth, and a thick, dark mane of hair.

While on [[StarForge Station]] Kanarak responded to a call by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij|Dhas Vedij]] to join the crew of the [[Rebel privateer]] vessel ''[[Far Orbit]]''.
